definitions.ask: Should -n combine with explicit -D days into one deduped run?
definitions.why: The day set already dedupes and sorts, so union composes with zero special cases.

choices.label: Merge into one sorted, deduped day set; -n 2 -D tomorrow syncs yesterday through tomorrow
Reject -n together with an explicit -D; each run uses one spelling

definitions.why: A full year covers any real catch-up and catches pasted-year typos like -n 2026.

choices.label: N must be 1..=366; larger values fail fast with a hint
